authorization: The Owner's explicit J16 instruction authorizes bounded multi-mesh harmonic studies, analytical comparison, targeted code and tests, and reproducible site assets. It excludes publication, release, tagging, and merge.

execution.retry_policy: Each mesh is a separate one-attempt case. No retry without a separately documented source/instrumentation change or diagnostic hypothesis, and a new contract/series/attempt-ledger entry.

boundary_conditions: RY=0 on bottom and top edges
RX=0 on left and right edges
model.complex_convention: (K + i*omega*C - omega^2*M) U = F with exp(+i*omega*t)

inputs.mesh_only_variable: Number of MITC4 quadrilaterals on each plan edge; geometry, thickness, material, pressure, supports, damping, observables, and frequency grid are held constant.
inputs.observable: Complex center UZ at the physical point (5,5,0) m. All three even meshes contain this point as a node.

reference.independence: Analytical odd/odd Navier series; no QF assembled matrices are used in the reference.
reference.theory: Thin Kirchhoff-Love plate; QF uses finite-mesh MITC4/Reissner-Mindlin shells.
reference.comparison_limit: Descriptive only. The shared geometry, material, density, damping, loading and simply-supported boundary definition do not remove finite-thickness and formulation differences.

methods_and_indicators.per_mesh: Assemble QF K, M and the harmonic load once for a raw SciPy spsolve sweep; separately call the QF direct_frequency route at every same frequency and record its exact status. The raw vector is never promoted when the route rejects.
methods_and_indicators.charge_check: Record assembler resultant and independently sum assembled translational nodal load entries; compare both with the analytical flat-area resultant (0,0,-10000) N. Record differences; this is a load-construction check, not solver acceptance.
methods_and_indicators.modal_indicator: Smallest generalized eigenfrequency from that mesh's QF-assembled K/M, reported separately from the damped frequency-response peak.
peak_indicators: Maximum amplitude sampled on the common 61-point dense grid.
Local quadratic estimate fitted to log amplitude around an interior sampled maximum; reported only as an estimate.
Navier damped peak estimate at 2.375818178440047 Hz and its sample on the common grid.
methods_and_indicators.amplitude_phase: Report amplitude and phase at all common frequencies; phase difference is omitted when the Navier amplitude is below 5 percent of its peak on the common dense grid.
methods_and_indicators.complex_error_normalization: |UZ_QF_raw - UZ_Navier| divided by the maximum Navier amplitude over the common dense grid. This is not a local relative error at each frequency.
methods_and_indicators.residuals: Report raw reduced-system relative L2 residual and infinity backward error. The existing QF residual guard remains unchanged at 1e-7; preserve every accepted, rejected, inconclusive, or harness status.
methods_and_indicators.prospective_completion_checks: Each mesh produces 62 frequency JSON/NPZ checkpoints, a summary, CSV, amplitude/phase plot, mesh/support/loading figure, peak deformation figure, and SHA-256 artifact manifest; no mechanical correlation PASS is defined.

resources.estimate: J15's 8x8, 152-frequency test took 42.849 s. The new 62-frequency grid is shorter, while the 10x10 model is larger; 30 minutes and 2 GiB soft RSS per mesh are conservative planning limits. This is an estimate, not a measurement.

artifacts_to_preserve: Per-frequency atomic JSON status and NPZ reduced/full response checkpoints, written before and then updated after the QF route.
Per-mesh site_data.json, CSV, figures, artifact manifest, load resultant, frequency and residual metrics.
Execution preflight, per-node attempt ledger, environment, source fingerprint, logs, measured time/RSS/output/archive size.
Historical J14/J15 attempts and verdicts unchanged.
